assertions: The response routes the request to the ase-ase-workflows-md sub-skill (finite-temperature trajectory), not static/relax/neb.
The response produces an ASE MD script with a timestep and a total number of steps and an NPT thermostat/barostat at 300 K / 1 atm.
The response defines a trajectory/output policy and a checkpoint/restart policy.
The response configures the MACE calculator on the water box and states the device assumption.
The response states an explicit initial-velocity policy and lists assumptions/unresolved choices.
The response does not point the user into the original atomistic-workflows source checkout.
